fightSong.title: Deeper
fightSong.lyrics: A mile deep and twice as wide / Grand Canyon pride, we never hide / Carved by time, built to last / Canyons running hard and fast!

stadium.name: The Rim
stadium.tradition: The Echo — PA announcer yells 'CAN-YON' and the crowd echoes for 8 seconds. If it lasts 10, it's 110 degrees out.

fanCulture.description: They wear wide-brim hats in September. After wins they do the echo clap. It's dry heat, it's deep pride.
fanCulture.tailgate: In shade, with misters, at 6am to beat the heat.

rivalries.name: The Desert Duel
rivalries.narrative: Desert vs desert. They have cards, we have canyons.

cityFlavor: 110 degrees, zero humidity, infinite views. We don't do winter.
